summary: Implement user registration form with firstname, lastname, email, password, and terms acceptance
description: Users must be able to register using a valid email and a secure password (minimum 8 characters, at least 1 number and 1 special character). Must check 'Agree to Terms' before submitting. On success, redirect to profile completion.
acceptance_criteria: Email must be in a valid format.
Email used must be unique, show validation error if already used email used again
Password must meet complexity rules (5+ chars, 1 number, 1 special char).
There should be password and confirm password field, password and confirm password field should be matched
If password and confirm password field not matched then show validation
Validation for firstname and lastname field for minimum and maximum allowed characters
Minimum of 2 and maximum of 10 characters are allowed in firstname and lastname field
Submit button disabled until terms are checked.
